title: Show the license and subscription state
summary: Shows how to get the client's ISecurityManager and read, without changing anything, the licensed state, whether the subscription is current and its expiry date (a double read as an OLE/TDateTime date).
phrasings: when does my Altium subscription expire
check if Altium Designer is licensed from an extension
